_metadata.description: miRNAs with documented abundant 3'-isomiRs (templated 3' extension/truncation and non-templated uridylation/adenylation). The stem-loop RT primer binds the 3'-terminal 6 nt, so 3' heterogeneity directly reduces RT capture efficiency for the affected isoforms.
_metadata.isomir_type: 3prime - templated shift and/or non-templated addition at the 3' end

Neilsen12.citation: Neilsen CT, Goodall GJ, Bracken CP. IsomiRs - the overlooked repertoire of regulatory microRNAs. Trends Genet 2012;28(11):544-549.

Wyman11.citation: Wyman SK, et al. Post-transcriptional generation of miRNA variants by multiple nucleotidyl transferases contributes to miRNA transcriptome complexity. Genome Res 2011;21(9):1450-1461.

Landgraf07.citation: Landgraf P, et al. A mammalian microRNA expression atlas based on small RNA library sequencing. Cell 2007;129(7):1401-1414.

evidence_levels.study_specific: Per-miRNA 3'-isomiR abundance reported in a specific dataset/table.
evidence_levels.review_supported: 3'-isomiR existence supported by a review or the general literature but without a per-miRNA abundance value here.

_metadata.coverage_warning: Partial coverage. Absence of an entry does NOT mean the miRNA lacks 3' isomiRs.
_metadata._curation_status: INITIALIZED EMPTY (Week2 C11). Per-miRNA entries require values transcribed from a cited paper/table with a real PMID/DOI and (where reported) an isoform_fraction_estimate; fabricated entries are NOT permitted. Add entries in the same shape as known_5prime_isomir_mirnas.json once a verified source is available.
